summary: Search associated recipe and material names in the Research Library.
details: The existing player-local translation window now resolves each technology caption with its unlock/productivity recipes and declared item/fluid products. The copied-data query searches those names separately from the technology caption and keeps stable action identities.

Partial translated search results share the existing deferred refresh. Subject, payload and saved-index budgets retain raw-ID fallback and show a limitation tooltip when coverage is incomplete. Pending callbacks retain their locale/catalogue generation boundaries.

Controlled actual-adapter, host-dispatch and query regressions pass. Current-package native localization, interaction, saves, multiplayer and performance remain pending; this draft fragment establishes no release acceptance.

Completes the 142 missing/stale governed keys in all 49 non-English locale memories through explicitly selected, machine-assisted drafts. The existing locale runner now preserves trusted unselected source/memory pairs instead of redrafting older entries; no human linguistic review is implied.
